vitals.triage_reason: slow breathing below 11/min, regular and without pauses

slow regular breathing looks the same in deep rest and in reduced consciousness; only a voice / responsiveness check separates them
cardiac motion (~0.1 mm) is not reliably resolvable through rubble and is not reported
vitals.source_reason: breathing-like rhythm in the human range
